sources.title: Study Guide for Exam DP-800: Developing AI-Enabled Database Solutions
sources.shortSummary: The current official guide still explicitly measures the March 12, 2026 outline. Its three domains retain weights 35-40%, 35-40% and 25-30%, with 11 skills and 73 subskills. The refreshed extraction has no objective-content change. This establishes scope, not technical correctness or feature availability.

sources.title: Develop AI-enabled database solutions
sources.shortSummary: The current DP-800T00-A course covers SQL Server, Azure SQL and SQL databases in Fabric. It is an ancestry-only preparation bridge: current credential HTML references its exact course UID, and current course HTML references the three self-paced path UIDs. The overview is not technical evidence for answers.

sources.title: Design and develop database solutions
sources.shortSummary: The current self-paced path links four modules for database objects, programmability, advanced T-SQL and AI-assisted SQL development. It supplies the finite preparation ancestry for the first domain. Exact implementation claims require the linked teaching units and their directly referenced product documentation.

sources.title: Secure, optimize, and deploy database solutions
sources.shortSummary: The current self-paced path links four modules covering SQL security, performance, SQL Database Projects CI/CD and Azure integration. It establishes the second domain's preparation ancestry, not approval of any particular permissions, isolation, deployment or API claim.

sources.title: Implement AI capabilities in database solutions
sources.shortSummary: The current self-paced path links the models and embeddings, intelligent search, and RAG modules. Its overview names Azure SQL Database and T-SQL AI workflows but does not establish maturity or exact API behavior. Supporting units and directly referenced product articles remain necessary.
